rules: spawn (AddEntity) sets the network target and the delta-codec base; pose defaults to STANDING and shared flags to 0 (pairing sends non-default values only)
relative move: target = decode(base, delta) exactly as VecDeltaCodec (zero delta keeps the base bit-exact), then base = target
teleport (TeleportEntity): target only (calculateAbsolute: (relative ? current : 0) + packet, pitch clamped); relative components INTERPOLATION_DEPENDENT; base untouched
removal ends the incarnation (DESPAWNED); a spawn on a live id replaces it (new incarnation); the old key answers ID_REUSED
world epoch change ends every incarnation; history never crosses epochs or sessions
updates for unknown ids are dropped (as the client does) and counted
256 retained summaries / 32 deep histories / 96 revisions / 3 s horizon; capacity refusal answers INCOMPLETE_COVERAGE
